props.title: Will the US make a decision during 2025 to withdraw their troops from South Korea?
props.shortTitle: American troops out of South Korea?
props.details:
Background: The US currently has close to 30 000 military personell stationed in South Korea. These troops are a part of the US extended deterrence. It appears as if the US increasingly consider the troops as a means for negotiation in the relations with South Korea, see for example Reuters.

Resolution: The question concerns a decision made at 31 December 2025 at the latest. The decision should concern all US troops in South Korea. The resolution is based on credible news sources.
